answer: New agents lock 60 POA in escrow for 20 epochs, each referral carved in marble on a public graph. Forging 1,000 identities locks 60,000 POA, pricing out bulk fakery. A referral cluster rising like a mesa, one sponsor fanning to hundreds, is flagged. A saffron-flagged dispute costs a peer 5 POA; confirmed fraud slashes the deposit, half to the challenger. Honest agents pay one deposit and keep their full reward, so honesty stays cheap.
